import hashlib,json,os,subprocess,sys
src,build=sys.argv[1],sys.argv[2]
def sha(p):
 return hashlib.sha256(open(p,'rb').read()).hexdigest()
a=os.path.join(src,'artifacts','author-release-mg'); v=os.path.join(src,'artifacts','verifier-release-mg')
DECLARED='21b5679f024849a844c7ea4994dfd2b295295647e4a836d7e543f7901eb56990'
oa=os.path.join(build,'author.text'); ov=os.path.join(build,'verifier.text')
for b,dst in ((a,oa),(v,ov)):
 r=subprocess.run(['objcopy','-O','binary','--only-section=.text',b,dst],capture_output=True,timeout=300)
 print(b,'objcopy rc',r.returncode,r.stderr.decode()[:300])
sa,sv=sha(a),sha(v); ta,tv=sha(oa),sha(ov)
sza,szv=os.path.getsize(a),os.path.getsize(v)
rec={'author_sha256':sa,'author_sha_matches_author_declaration':sa==DECLARED,
 'verifier_sha256':sv,'full_file_sha_differ':sa!=sv,
 'text_sha256_author':ta,'text_sha256_verifier':tv,'text_equal':ta==tv,
 'size_author':sza,'size_verifier':szv,'size_delta':sza-szv}
print(json.dumps(rec,indent=1))
ok=(sa==DECLARED and ta==tv)
print('VERDICT','PASS' if ok else 'FAIL')
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
